moments.action: In a school cafeteria the American student hunches over his tray fumbling chopsticks while the friend in the white durag talks beside him; by the second shot he has stopped eating and turned a flat stare on him.
The friend answers with a sideways glance; the student jabs at his food. The angle widens to a two-shot with classmates behind them and a dark steering wheel resting on the table beside the trays.
The student scowls down at his tray, the camera drops to the steering wheel laid by his elbow, then he leans in talking and the friend comes back grinning.
They keep trading lines across lunch, the student flat and skeptical, the friend laughing him off; by the last shot the friend is smirking straight at him, the pitch made.

Night street: pedestrians cross in front of a lit automated garage bay. The student, backpack on, and the friend, now in a red beanie with a steering wheel under his arm, stop to face the lift; the student turns to look at him.
The lift shuffles its platforms behind the glass, a yellow sports car and a black roadster sliding past, while the two wait in the street; a bright green car finally drops into the opening.
Close on the green car's tailgate, embossed with a huge clenched green fist and forearm; cut back to the street and the friend is beaming while the student stays blank.
The green minivan sits out of the lift and the pair walk in to it; at the side window a shaggy green monster toy is propped up in the driver's seat.
In the street the student grips his backpack straps, unimpressed; they face the van's nose with its brush bolted across the roof, and the friend ends up laughing openly at him.
